name: 林小羊
audience: 同事年会群、熟悉同事私聊
purpose: 同时容纳期待、参与、紧张和体面收尾，表演和喝酒保留选择

stickers.caption: 排练中
stickers.pose: Sheep awkwardly practices a tiny dance step, one hoof up one hoof sideways, body bent uncertainly, small plain floor tape mark under feet, simple red bow tie, sheepish face. No text on floor.

stickers.caption: 怎么是我
stickers.usage_note: 表达紧张，避免把同事画成恶意角色
stickers.pose: Sheep shrinks into a tiny low wool mound under a small warm spotlight cone, one plain microphone aimed toward it on stand, eyes tiny and surprised, ears droop. Isolated spotlight shape not background panel.

stickers.caption: 我负责鼓掌
stickers.usage_note: 提供无需表演的参与方式
stickers.pose: Sheep seated low cheerfully clapping two little hooves, three clear clap motion strokes, small grin and crescent eyes, no props; body bounces slightly.

stickers.caption: 坐等抽奖
stickers.usage_note: 真实期待与玩笑，不承诺中奖
stickers.pose: Sheep suddenly sits perfectly upright on a tiny stool, hooves placed neatly on knees, huge attentive dot eyes directed forward, holds one plain raffle ticket with no text or digits.

stickers.caption: 这次到我
stickers.usage_note: 用实际上下文区分期待与已中奖
stickers.pose: Sheep springs up from a low crouch raising one plain ticket high, eyes delighted, free hoof pointing toward own chest, two small gold confetti bits, no prize logos.

stickers.caption: 重在参与
stickers.usage_note: 保留体面，不嘲笑别人的奖品
stickers.pose: Sheep slumps on a low stool hugging one tiny plain consolation gift box, small watery dot eyes but crooked soft smile, lone small confetti piece falling, gentle not tragic.

stickers.caption: 我先开吃
stickers.usage_note: 等主持或同桌确认开席后使用
stickers.pose: Sheep leans forward eagerly with simple bowl and spoon in hooves, round wool body stretched toward bowl, bright tiny eyes, no alcohol, no chopsticks stuck upright in rice.

stickers.caption: 今晚辛苦啦
stickers.usage_note: 感谢组织、后勤或表演者的付出
stickers.pose: Sheep softly tired with loosened little red bow tie, offers one small warm heart with both hooves and gives a small sincere bow, two tiny confetti flecks at feet, clean isolated shape.
